evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 4.9 ppm after remaining near 5 ppm during the ramp.
Oxygen increased to 13.4 ppm during growth.
Oxygen reached 33.3 ppm, a sustained departure from the post-purge baseline.
Temperature 750.1 °C and Ar flow 100.5 sccm match their setpoints; pressure remains near baseline at 760.6 Torr and controller reports running.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen validation and gas-supply/leak checks are needed to distinguish air ingress from gas contamination, outgassing, or sensor error; sample characterization is not yet available.
